```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(move2)

print("hello1")

# Set up Movebank credentials and get data
move2::movebank_store_credentials(
  username = Sys.getenv("MOVEBANK_USERNAME"), 
  password = Sys.getenv("MOVEBANK_PASSWORD")
)

print("hello3")

# Download study details
study_details <- move2::movebank_download_study_info(i_am_collaborator = TRUE)

print("hello2")

# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Movebank Studies"),
  DT::dataTableOutput("table")
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output) {
  output$table <- DT::renderDataTable({
    DT::datatable(
      study_details,
      options = list(
        pageLength = 10,
        scrollX = TRUE
      )
    )
  })
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
